title: Add Android hardware buffer support to ExternalTexture in the RD renderers
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Related to #65778 and #97163

I'm building handheld AR on Godot, and on Android the camera image comes from ARCore as an `AHardwareBuffer`. So do Camera2 frames through `AImageReader` and MediaCodec output. Compatibility can show these through `ExternalTexture`, but in Forward+ and Mobile `texture_external_initialize()` and `texture_external_update()` are empty, so the only option there is copying every frame through the CPU. For ARCore at 1080p that's about 1.3 ms of repacking and uploading per frame (2.4 ms at p95).

This adds:

```gdscript
ExternalTexture.submit_hardware_buffer(buffer: int, color_model := COLOR_MODEL_AUTOMATIC, color_range := COLOR_RANGE_AUTOMATIC, crop := Rect2i(), completion := Callable()) -> Error
```

It can be called from any thread. At the start of the next frame the newest submission is imported without a copy and converted into an ordinary RGBA texture behind the `ExternalTexture`'s RID, and older ones are dropped. `completion` runs on the main thread once the GPU is done with the buffer, which is when an `AImage` can go back to its `AImageReader`. It returns `ERR_UNAVAILABLE` where the device can't do it.

Converting into a normal texture means canvas items, materials, visual shaders and both `sampler2D` and `samplerExternalOES` uniforms work unchanged. Sampling the buffer directly would need the immutable YCbCr sampler in every material pipeline and in the canvas batcher. The pass costs one RGBA write per frame, and the producer gets its buffer back as soon as it has run.

On the Vulkan side, `VK_ANDROID_external_memory_android_hardware_buffer`, `VK_EXT_queue_family_foreign` and `samplerYcbcrConversion` are enabled when the device has them, and `RenderingDevice.SUPPORTS_ANDROID_HARDWARE_BUFFER` reports the result. Vendor and YUV formats go through a YCbCr conversion in an immutable combined sampler. The image is acquired from and released to the foreign queue family around the conversion. `AHardwareBuffer_*` is loaded with `dlsym`, so the minimum SDK stays at 24.

An explicit colour model or range always wins over the driver's suggestion, because the suggestion can be wrong: for CPU-written YUV buffers the Pixel 6 suggests BT.601 narrow at SD sizes and BT.709 narrow at 1080p, whatever the content. Input is treated as SDR. Compatibility is unchanged.

The first commit is a prerequisite. Immutable samplers are now matched by set as well as binding, are part of the uniform set format, and can be combined samplers, which the YCbCr conversion needs. `RD::Uniform::immutable_sampler` goes away, since the shader now says which bindings are immutable.

## Additional information

Tested on a Pixel 6 (Mali-G78, Android 17) with the validation layer and sync validation on, in Safe and Separate thread modes: CPU-written YUV and RGBA buffers checked against a reference for each colour model and range, Camera2 `PRIVATE` buffers, MediaCodec output with frame index checks and the decoder's padding cropped, coalescing, resubmission, pause and resume, quitting with submissions in flight, and a 30 minute camera soak (53,944 frames, none dropped or failed, flat memory). With ARCore at 1080p it keeps up at 30 Hz, costs about 36 µs per frame to submit, and matches ARCore's CPU image within 0.31/255 as BT.601 full range.

The validation layer reports nothing from this code. The only messages it shows are also there on master with a project that only idles.

The unit tests only cover argument checks and the stable RID, since the rest needs real hardware buffers. Not tested on Adreno or any other vendor. Desktop Vulkan, Metal and D3D12 report the feature as unsupported (checked on Metal).

The main thing I'd like feedback on is the semantics: in Compatibility `ExternalTexture` is an external texture that only `samplerExternalOES` can read, while here it's an ordinary texture. #124374 is related as it gives unassigned `samplerExternalOES` uniforms a default texture in RD.
